blocks.text: The Downtown Topeka Urban Design Standards adopted by reference as part of the downtown Topeka master plan (Ordinance No. 20294 ) shall be used for all new development within the D-1, D-2, and D-3 districts. (Ord. 20340 § 3, 2-1-22.)
